video.title: AI欧腐《诱敌入怀/Lure The Foe Into Arms》
video.desc:
To avenge his sister, Elliot infiltrates the Soren estate and seduces Joanna’s fiancé, Sebastian. But revenge turns real when they fall for each other. Even after learning the truth, Sebastian saves Elliot, ends the engagement, reopens the old case, and brings Joanna to justice. With revenge behind him, Elliot accepts Sebastian’s proposal.
为了替姐姐复仇，Elliot潜入Soren家族，刻意接近并引诱Joanna的未婚夫Sebastian。
可这场以复仇为名的算计，却在两人相处中逐渐变成真心。即便得知真相后，Sebastian依然选择救下Elliot，解除与Joanna的婚约，重启当年的旧案，并将Joanna绳之以法。
当仇恨终于落幕，Elliot也放下过去，接受了Sebastian的求婚。
